北京.name: 北京
北京.ai_briefing_zh: 北京阴冷，体感 -4℃，记得多穿衣保暖哦！
北京.ai_briefing_en: Beijing is gloomy and cold, feels like -4℃. Remember to dress warmly!

慈溪.name: 慈溪
慈溪.ai_briefing_zh: 慈溪多云，体感 3℃，风力 3级，出门添件外套吧。
慈溪.ai_briefing_en: Cixi is cloudy, feels like 3℃ with 3-level wind. Grab a jacket before heading out.

上海.name: 上海
上海.ai_briefing_zh: 上海阳光正好 6℃，体感 3℃，出门晒晒太阳很舒服。
上海.ai_briefing_en: Shanghai is sunny and 6℃, feels like 3℃. Enjoy the sunshine, it's lovely out!

广州.name: 广州
广州.ai_briefing_zh: 广州阴天 11℃，体感 7℃。风有点大，记得多穿。
广州.ai_briefing_en: Guangzhou is cloudy and 11℃, feels like 7℃. It's a bit windy, remember to dress warmer.

深圳.name: 深圳
深圳.ai_briefing_zh: 深圳阴天 13℃，体感 10℃。早晚温差大，注意保暖。
深圳.ai_briefing_en: Shenzhen is cloudy and 13℃, feels like 10℃. Mind the temperature difference between morning and night.

杭州.name: 杭州
杭州.ai_briefing_zh: 杭州阳光 6℃，体感 2℃。风力不大，享受阳光吧！
杭州.ai_briefing_en: Hangzhou is sunny and 6℃, feels like 2℃. Light wind, enjoy the sun!

南京.name: 南京
南京.ai_briefing_zh: 南京阳光 5℃，体感 0℃。虽然有太阳，也要注意保暖。
南京.ai_briefing_en: Nanjing is sunny and 5℃, feels like 0℃. Despite the sun, remember to stay warm.

成都.name: 成都
成都.ai_briefing_zh: 成都阴天 12℃，体感 10℃。湿度有点高，出门带伞哦。
成都.ai_briefing_en: Chengdu is cloudy and 12℃, feels like 10℃. Humidity is high, bring an umbrella.

武汉.name: 武汉
武汉.ai_briefing_zh: 武汉阳光 8℃，体感 4℃。虽然有太阳，别忘了添衣。
武汉.ai_briefing_en: Wuhan is sunny and 8℃, feels like 4℃. Despite the sun, don't forget to layer up.

西安.name: 西安
西安.ai_briefing_zh: 西安晴朗 5℃，体感 1℃。空气干燥，记得多喝水。
西安.ai_briefing_en: Xi'an is sunny and 5℃, feels like 1℃. Air is dry, remember to drink more water.

重庆.name: 重庆
重庆.ai_briefing_zh: 重庆阴天 11℃，体感 9℃。湿度较大，注意防潮。
重庆.ai_briefing_en: Chongqing is cloudy and 11℃, feels like 9℃. High humidity, mind the dampness.

哈尔滨.name: 哈尔滨
哈尔滨.ai_briefing_zh: 哈尔滨 -20℃ 寒风凛冽，务必全副武装防寒！
哈尔滨.ai_briefing_en: Harbin is a frosty -20℃ with biting winds. Be sure to bundle up completely!
哈尔滨.alert: 🥶 红色极寒警报：体感低至 -27℃

沈阳.name: 沈阳
沈阳.ai_briefing_zh: 沈阳晴朗 -13℃，体感 -18℃。出门注意防寒保暖哦。
沈阳.ai_briefing_en: Shenyang is sunny and -13℃, feels like -18℃. Remember to dress warmly when going out.
沈阳.alert: ❄️ 橙色寒冷提示：体感低至 -18℃

昆明.name: 昆明
昆明.ai_briefing_zh: 昆明多云 12℃，体感 9℃。气温适中，但风力较大。
昆明.ai_briefing_en: Kunming is cloudy and 12℃, feels like 9℃. Moderate temperature, but it's windy.

厦门.name: 厦门
厦门.ai_briefing_zh: 厦门晴朗 13℃，体感 9℃。风力 4级，注意防风。
厦门.ai_briefing_en: Xiamen is sunny and 13℃, feels like 9℃. Winds are at level 4, mind the strong gusts.

青岛.name: 青岛
青岛.ai_briefing_zh: 青岛阳光 3℃，体感 -1℃。风力 3级，海边注意保暖。
青岛.ai_briefing_en: Qingdao is sunny and 3℃, feels like -1℃. 3-level wind, stay warm, especially by the sea.

大连.name: 大连
大连.ai_briefing_zh: 大连多云 -4℃，体感 -8℃。注意防寒，别着凉了。
大连.ai_briefing_en: Dalian is cloudy and -4℃, feels like -8℃. Stay warm and don't catch a cold.
